sideFinding.statement: JavaLocator.FindAsync() costs 311 ms on EVERY diagnosis, purely to fill javaVersion in the report
sideFinding.relationToMR21: MR21 judged sanitize (11-30 ms) the slowest among its chosen service-layer metrics, but it never measured the diagnose end-to-end, so it did not see this 311 ms. MR21's conclusion holds within its scope but is NOT the dominant cost on this user-visible path.
sideFinding.suggestedFix: cache the Java probe (invalidated by java path + mtime), or let diagnosis proceed without javaVersion (report "unknown"); either cuts local diagnosis from ~327 ms to ~16 ms (-95%)
sideFinding.risk: a cache would show a stale Java version right after the user switches Java; path+mtime invalidation avoids it but needs invalidation test cases
sideFinding.authorizationRequired: yes - the plan requires bottleneck fixes to go through a separate precise sub-package
